en: A black and white postcard image showing a rugged stone monument in a wooded park setting. The monument features a relief portrait of a man, with the name 'JÓKAI MÓR' clearly inscribed underneath. The base of the monument is covered in ivy, and it is encircled by decorative posts with chains. The area looks quiet and natural, with trees and a pathway visible in the background.
